description: This file defines a class for configuring and transforming requests and responses for Volcengine embedding models, including URL construction, parameter mapping, request transformation, response parsing, environment validation, and error handling.

classes.name: VolcEngineEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Volcengine embedding models, providing methods for URL generation, parameter mapping, request/response transformation, environment validation, and error handling.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the configuration object, setting optional parameters.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Returns the configuration dictionary from the superclass.

methods.name: get_supported_openai_params
methods.description: Returns a list of supported OpenAI parameters for Volcengine embedding models.

methods.name: get_complete_url
methods.description: Constructs the full API URL for Volcengine embedding requests based on base URL.

methods.name: map_openai_params
methods.description: Maps OpenAI-style parameters to Volcengine-specific parameters, with validation.

methods.name: transform_embedding_request
methods.description: Transforms input data and optional parameters into Volcengine API request format.

methods.name: transform_embedding_response
methods.description: Transforms the raw HTTP response into an EmbeddingResponse object, matching Volcengine's response format.

methods.name: validate_environment
methods.description: Validates and prepares headers for environment, including authentication.

methods.name: get_error_class
methods.description: Creates and returns a specific error class for handling Volcengine errors.
